editorial_mode.note: From 2026-09-29, include only timely facts not reported in any delivered private or group brief. A material new result on a known topic is eligible only for the new evidence, not a recap. The 2026-09-28 first group issue was a one-time exception.

research_watchlist.name: AMI Labs
track: technical explanations linked to primary evidence
research_watchlist.attribution_rule: Separate AMI-affiliated work, LeCun coauthored work and work merely discussed by LeCun; verify affiliation per paper.

coverage_policy.public_discovery_window: Asia/Shanghai calendar dates D-7 through D, inclusive; re-search the full window daily rather than cutting off at the last delivered brief
coverage_policy.candidate_novelty: Any in-window report not covered in a delivered brief is a new-information candidate, even if the underlying paper or event is older; retain separate report, event and original-publication dates

lanes.name: 学术

lanes.name: 产业与同行
lanes.search_intent: 具身公司产品发布、能力演示、客户部署、合作与融资中对技术或市场判断有影响的变化

lanes.name: 工业与场景
lanes.search_intent: 制造、仓储、零售理货、家庭服务等具身系统的真实部署、任务完成率、成本、可靠性和集成约束

lanes.name: 前沿科学
lanes.search_intent: 神经科学、认知科学、控制、仿真与新型感知对具身学习或行动有明确启发的成果

coverage_policy.discovery_rule: 按docs/discovery-map.md的分层来源与多轴技术叶子动态检索并查漏；记录检查时间、候选、遗漏/失败；不强制每类每天入选，不把未发现等同于没有更新。检索策略和标签不进入正文。
coverage_policy.breaking_rule: 高度相关且有可核实原始来源的突发成果进入待广播队列；若此前已报道，日报只汇报新增的实质证据。该规则本身未启用实时监听；每日定时群发由单独授权任务执行。
